title: Security — HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc
claims: Individual accident insurance covering search and rescue in France, Italy and Switzerland is mandatory for every runner; helicopter repatriation is quoted at €800–3,000.
A smartphone with international roaming must stay switched on for the whole race, and airplane mode is explicitly prohibited because LiveRun by LiveTrail is used for safety.
For runners spending more than 15 hours on the course, an external battery is strongly recommended.
The emergency contact number entered on the runner page should be the number actually carried during the race.

claimVerification.note: 保险段明确要求覆盖法意瑞三国搜救，并给出直升机转运 800–3000 欧元的区间。
手机段明确禁止飞行模式，并说明 LiveRun 用于安全追踪。
手机段写明超过 15 小时强烈建议外接电池。
页面要求核对紧急联系人电话，并可在起跑前更新。
